Match box-score columns (home_shots, corners, fouls, cards) are in-match outcome variables. They MUST NOT be used directly as pre-match prediction features. They can only be used as historical trailing rolling averages (e.g., trailing 5-game average shots) with strict lag-1 shifts.

Pinnacle Closing Odds are recorded seconds before kickoff. If a predictive model claims to generate betting predictions hours or days in advance, using closing odds as an input feature constitutes look-ahead bias. Closing odds should only be used as a benchmarking target (Closing Line Value / CLV), not as an input feature.

details: The aggregated columns home_lineup_value_m and home_players_fielded were constructed by filtering to players with minutes > 0 in that specific match. In a true pre-match setting, confirmed lineups are only released 60-75 minutes before kickoff, and in-game substitutions cannot be known beforehand. Using these directly causes post-whistle leakage.
